answer: Flooding registration pushes an farming party to the back of the cedar queue while genuine members promoted earlier keep earning. Admission is quota-limited: at most 1182 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the thread. The saffron index is deterministic from ledger replay, which means nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. That is 13 dollars per alias. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
